boundary: local synthetic exact sealed runtime; not hosted, provider, production or customer proof
risk: The immutable-evidence validator skipped every pre-seal leave-decision command row. After upgrading an existing database, an approved or declined legacy request therefore remained authoritative even though no immutable evidence bound its decision, reviewer, timestamp, reason or digest.

failFirst.test: upgrade quarantines a decided leave request that predates immutable evidence

repair.policy: Fail closed instead of manufacturing trust from mutable historical state.
requirements: Every approved or declined request has exactly one version-1 append-only seal.
The generic result ID and sealed request ID agree.
Every sealed request exists and its exact decision fields and canonical digest agree.
repair.operatorAction: Reviewed reconciliation or quarantine is required before legacy decisions can return to service.

limitations: This intentionally provides no automatic migration: copying mutable legacy fields into a new seal would falsely upgrade unverified history.
A separately authorised reconciliation workflow and evidence source are required for any real legacy records.
